# Ways of Working with the Client

How we show up on client calls, starting with standup. The client joins
standup from 2026-08-26. This page sets the rules for that room.

## Standups are static updates

With the client present, standup stays a status report: what I did, what I
am doing, what is blocking me. Nothing else. Save discussion, debate, and
design work for our own channels.

## No solutioning on the call

Do not design in front of the client. If a question surfaces that needs
design work, name it as a follow-up and take it offline.

## The stack is decided

Do not re-litigate the stack on a client call. The decisions are recorded as
ADRs under `product/inputs/reference/decisions/`. Point at those instead of
reopening the argument.

## No petty bickering

Disagreements go to our own channels first. Come back to the client with one
answer.

## Act like the experts we are

We know this work. Carry that into the room.

## Escalation path

Pramod first, then KV. John Kilgore for anything that needs wrangling.
